### Nextpower to Showcase Expanded Power Technology and Services Platform at RE+ 2026


November 12, 2026


*Innovation Showroom will feature solutions spanning power generation, energy storage, power conversion, and new lifecycle services*


FREMONT, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Nextpower™](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fnextpower.com%2F&esheet=54640534&newsitemid=20261112912644&lan=en-US&anchor=Nextpower%26%238482%3B&index=1&md5=26dbb0e9eb172bc9ff599fd4419bd3b9) (Nasdaq: NXT), a leading provider of clean power generation and energy storage solutions, will introduce new lifecycle services and showcase a series of product and commercial milestones across solar generation, power collection and conversion, and energy storage at RE+ 2026.


Nextpower’s integrated medium-voltage (MV) power conversion platform for utility-scale solar, storage, and hybrid projects.


One year after becoming Nextpower (formerly Nextracker), the company will demonstrate how its solutions support modern energy infrastructure, from utility-scale power plants to behind-the-meter power systems. Nextpower’s integrated power technology platform is designed to help improve project economics at multiple points in the lifecycle—from accelerating installation and increasing energy production to improving long-term performance and reducing operating and weather-related risk.


In 2025, technology based on Nextpower’s platform supported approximately 30% of all new U.S. power generation capacity added to the grid, underscoring the scale at which the company’s technologies are being deployed.


“The world needs more electricity, and the infrastructure required to deliver it at scale is becoming more complex,” said Dan Shugar, founder and CEO of Nextpower. “We continue to find new ways to solve that complexity and drive greater value for our customers. Beyond our roots in the solar power industry, we are also now solving challenges for a broader set of industrial applications including AI data centers, where customers are looking for bankable technology partners that can bring innovative solutions and stand behind them for the full lifecycle.”


“At RE+ 2026, we're putting our power technology platform on full display with new products and technologies, a consolidated new services business, and more commercial deployments at scale. This is why we say ‘What’s Next is Here.’”[Watch our video](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fyoutu.be%2FTArH-mfMZL4%3Fsi%3DAlnRFtD_UghmW09i&esheet=54640534&newsitemid=20261112912644&lan=en-US&anchor=Watch+our+video&index=2&md5=0bdae6202749effb8d1a2e0dbe4e97b0) for an overview of Nextpower's power technology platform.


**Introducing Nextpower Services**


Nextpower’s expanded services business spans design, deployment, and operations, combining robotic services, field operations, tools and specialized expertise, as well as software and data intelligence to help customers streamline construction, maximize energy production, proactively identify issues, and work to reduce operating risk across the power plant. At RE+, the company will showcase new robotic technology enabled services, including new panel-cleaning robots that are entering commercial-scale deployment and a panel soiling monitor solution already fully commercialized.[Watch our video](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fyoutu.be%2FgIsl1iMiQu8%3Fsi%3DG5sp7-iXpoWQhoiE&esheet=54640534&newsitemid=20261112912644&lan=en-US&anchor=Watch+our+video&index=3&md5=5681be95524c4bf25647934d2720a297) to see these new technologies in action.


**Power Conversion**


Nextpower’s power conversion systems for utility-scale solar and energy storage applications are now shipping, with U.S. domestic manufacturing ramping to meet a multi-GW backlog. A deeper explanation of the company's modular, cyber-secure power conversion products and customer-enabled service program can be found[on the Nextpower blog](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fnextpower.com%2Fpost%2Fblog%2Fnew-model-for-central-inverter-service-is-here-nextpower-power-conversion-explained%3Flocale%3Den-US&esheet=54640534&newsitemid=20261112912644&lan=en-US&anchor=on+the+Nextpower+blog&index=4&md5=afd817f141820195ef478a56b0157bf4) .


**Energy Storage Systems**


Nextpower’s energy storage systems combine integrated battery technology in AC or DC blocks with intelligent power controls, including its Hybrid Power Stabilizer (HPS) for behind-the-meter data center applications. Nextpower recently received a Certificate of Approval from the New York City Fire Department (FDNY), following a rigorous review process for battery energy storage system safety. More information on the role of energy storage systems with power stabilization capabilities for AI data centers can be found[on the Nextpower blog](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fnextpower.com%2Fpost%2Fblog%2Fwhy-ai-data-centers-need-active-power-stabilization-not-just-backup-batteries%3Flocale%3Den-US&esheet=54640534&newsitemid=20261112912644&lan=en-US&anchor=on+the+Nextpower+blog&index=5&md5=f3ab1851d1a8910a2e53ee725781e045) .


**Trackers, Foundations, and Enabling Construction Automation**


- Nextpower's new rapid rail module mounting system accelerates rail installation for its flagship NX Horizon ® tracker portfolio by up to 30 percent with a simplified design that eliminates torque checking. Its self-closing design improves installation repeatability, enables automated construction processes, and can include pre-installed wire management components.[Watch our video](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fyoutu.be%2Fw1Kpi9ghAAY&esheet=54640534&newsitemid=20261112912644&lan=en-US&anchor=Watch+our+video&index=6&md5=bff7e41227edab659d57e21d5c824a51) to see Nextpower rapid rail construction in action.
- Nextpower continues to expand its suite of integrated foundation solutions and services offerings. The upgraded NX Earth Truss™ foundation system now enables 75-degree Hail Pro™ stow capability, and the semi-automated NX Truss Driver ® fleet has grown to more than 100 machines globally.
- Nextpower is expanding its Automation Partner Program to support the development and adoption of automated solar construction processes. Visit[Nextpower's Automation Partners page](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fnextpower.com%2Fautomation-partners&esheet=54640534&newsitemid=20261112912644&lan=en-US&anchor=Nextpower%27s+Automation+Partners+page&index=7&md5=ad3e0cd6268602c8ba8d47c52b98148d) to learn how to become a partner.


**Electrical Balance of Systems (eBOS)**


Nextpower is introducing a tracker-integrated wire management system featuring pre-installed components at RE+. This offering expands Nextpower’s eBOS portfolio, which includes both string combiner and trunk solutions, including its patented NX PowerMerge™ trunk bus system, now at commercial scale deployment. More information on the value of integrating eBOS design into early stage project engineering can be found[on the Nextpower blog](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fnextpower.com%2Fpost%2Fblog%2Felevating-ebos-in-utility-scale-solar-q-and-a-with-ryan-schofield%3Flocale%3Den-US&esheet=54640534&newsitemid=20261112912644&lan=en-US&anchor=on+the+Nextpower+blog&index=8&md5=48fd8af51bd6f03a07cc3c60914bfb56) .


**Advanced Module Frames**


Nextpower’s advanced NX CoreFrame™ is now shipping, with multiple new U.S. partner factories coming online for an aggregate U.S. steel frame production capacity of over 6.5 GW expected in 2027. NX CoreFrame will be on display at multiple solar module customer booths at RE+ 2026. More details on structural, economic, and supply-chain advantages of advanced steel frames can be found[in this whitepaper](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fnextpower.com%2Fpost%2Fwhitepaper%2Freinforcing-the-future-of-solar-nx-coreframe%3Flocale%3Den-US&esheet=54640534&newsitemid=20261112912644&lan=en-US&anchor=in+this+whitepaper&index=9&md5=7cf84144991c6bd5641909ab3d98706c) .


**What's Next Is at RE+ 2026**


Nextpower will showcase its integrated technology platform at RE+ 2026, Nov. 16-19, at the Las Vegas Convention Center. Visit the main Nextpower booth ( **N1104** ) to explore solutions spanning solar, power conversion, software and services, and stop by the energy storage booth ( **W17131** ) to see how storage and power stabilization fit into the platform. To arrange a demo in the Innovation Showroom, please contact your Nextpower representative. Visit the[Nextpower RE+ landing page](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fnextpower.com%2Freplus&esheet=54640534&newsitemid=20261112912644&lan=en-US&anchor=Nextpower+RE%2B+landing+page&index=10&md5=ba4a328eaaa886b6e86967311b7b282f) for event news, resources, and a full speaker schedule.


**Nextpower Capital Markets Day**


Nextpower will host its Capital Markets Day in Las Vegas on Monday, November 16, beginning at 3 p.m. Pacific Time. Due to limited capacity, attendance in person is by invitation only. To register for the live webcast, visit Nextpower's[investor website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.nextpower.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54640534&newsitemid=20261112912644&lan=en-US&anchor=investor+website&index=11&md5=942c88308d115bafc9f4d4db22ece1bf) .


**About Nextpower**


Nextpower™ (Nasdaq: NXT) innovates and delivers integrated technology solutions for modern energy infrastructure. Its solar and energy storage platforms help customers design, build, and operate utility-scale power plants and other critical power infrastructure with faster project delivery, improved system performance, greater reliability, and long-term operational value. Building on more than a decade of energy technology leadership, Nextpower partners with customers worldwide to accelerate the deployment of reliable firm power needed for a rapidly electrifying world. Learn more at[www.nextpower.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nextpower.com%2F&esheet=54640534&newsitemid=20261112912644&lan=en-US&anchor=www.nextpower.com&index=12&md5=0e7389cc08cb5ef8fae03314f9d5254c) .
